title: One trace for every type
quote: Standardize the trace across all our types; brain (aip-836d) builds and maintains it.
means: Every type is traced the same way: its type doc says which events write its docs (what, in which step, by which kind of author), every doc shows the same trace, and aip-836d (brain) builds it and keeps it, its check enforcing it.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-4d06 that held
